blocks.text: On October 30, 2026, OPM rap icon Gloc-9 gives that familiar Filipino invitation a new sound with the worldwide release of “Tara G!”, a collaboration with GameZone inspired by friendship, shared experiences, and the Filipino spirit of samahan. Known for turning everyday Filipino realities into music, Gloc-9 brings his distinctive storytelling to a phrase heard everywhere – from spontaneous plans with friends to moments shared with family and community. Gloc-9 Turns an Everyday Filipino Expression Into Music Throughout his career, Gloc-9 has built a reputation for transforming distinctly Filipino stories and everyday experiences into music.
